verdict.rationale: Conductor documents routines that run agents via a GitHub Action, which lets a developer kick off agent work from GitHub. It can also create workspaces from GitHub or Linear issues, but that happens inside the Conductor app rather than from those tools. There is no evidence of GitLab or Slack triggers. Missing for 10: GitLab triggering, Slack triggering, launching tasks directly from within Linear, and detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the GitHub Action trigger.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
create a workspace from a branch, pull request, GitHub issue, or Linear issue
